hook: Thailand and Cambodia hold rival claims over 27,000 square kilometers of the Gulf of Thailand.

sections.voiceover: Thailand and Cambodia hold rival claims over 27,000 square kilometers of the Gulf of Thailand.
b_roll: Map of the Gulf of Thailand seabed

sections.voiceover: On September 15, foreign ministers from Thailand and Cambodia delivered statements in Singapore. The neighbors share an 800 kilometer land border alongside rival maritime territorial claims. Could $300 billion in seabed resources spark a clash in the Gulf of Thailand?
However, Thailand pulled out of their 2001 agreement to exploit those resources.
Cambodia sought international conciliation because Thailand pulled out of their 2001 agreement. Mediation talks at The Hague led both nations to use a naval hotline.
The 27,000 square kilometer seabed remains contested.
